verdict.rationale: The evidence implies git and PR workflows. The cloud agent works autonomously 'just like a human developer' and can be asked via @copilot on an existing pull request to make changes. The desktop workspace lets you review and merge completed work, and the GitHub MCP server lets Copilot Chat interact with repositories and pull requests. None of these items explicitly documents the agent staging changes, writing commit messages, creating branches, or opening a PR itself. Missing for 10: explicit docs on agent-driven staging and commit-message generation, branch creation, PR opening, and hands-on corroboration.
